GlobalConfig._comment_Path: Absolute path to a JSON file, outside the repo and never committed, holding this environment's actual OpenSearch:Uri/ProductCatalogSnapshot:ConnectionString values (PLATFORM_BLUEPRINT.md Configuration Management). Program.cs layers it on top of this file at startup and fails fast if the path is unset or missing. Local dev sets the concrete path in appsettings.Local.json; a deployed environment supplies it via the GlobalConfig__Path env var pointing at a mounted secret file.

OpenSearch._comment_Uri: Secret — supplied via the GlobalConfig file, never committed (PLATFORM_BLUEPRINT.md Configuration Management).

ProductCatalogSnapshot._comment_ConnectionString: Secret — supplied via the GlobalConfig file, never committed. Read-only connection string against a read-replica of kart-product-service's PostgreSQL write side (database-design.md's Rebuild Backfill Mechanism). Cross-repo, operator-provided (PLATFORM_BLUEPRINT.md Configuration Management).
